Every mutation revalidates expected head/ownership/allowlist; wrong actor/head/paths, hold, failed/missing required checks, review nonapproval, missing/expired credential and malformed status refuse.
No candidate source/uv build/import/hook execution occurs in write/reviewer credential jobs; publisher lacks status/check-writing permissions and candidate artifacts cannot forge merge authority.

Replay interruption at push success/PR failure, merge success/API timeout, artifact missing, adoption fail and final pin read; one adoption PR, truthful issue updates and no force overwrite user edits.
Production no-write dry-run reports exact proposed mutations and kill switch halts mutations while preserving open PRs; normal current-head review+CI; merged BenchBox PR.

description:
Extend existing script/workflow, hourly+dispatch, pinned trusted develop code and concurrency, stateless reconciliation from GitHub PRs/refs/runs, no DB/webhook/sleeping runner. Fork-current/consumer-stale must continue. Ignore tooling-only fork-main movement at already adopted runtime version. Skip unchanged failed input fingerprints until changed inputs or explicit retry. Validate controller-owned PR repo/base/author/branch/head, all required trusted CI and holds/requests; protected PUT merge with exact sha and merge method, no fork auto-merge setting change. Require all merged-SHA checks before wheel acquisition.

Prepare adoption read-only with local QuestDB, changelog, identity/evidence receipt and git bundle. Allowed paths only archive/pin/notice/baseline identity/changelog, never test/golden/outcome changes. Publish with BenchBox App Contents/PR-write only; isolated from source execution and reviewer credentials. REST bot publication is narrowly documented, not a bypass of ordinary agent policy. Confirm App PR triggers actual CI/oracle. Link exact CI gate report rather than duplicate gate run. Use existing pr-arm exact HEAD/trunk/hold/oracle/five-CI/thread/duration/squash controls; no local pr-open/gateway/pr-ready in CI or parallel raw BenchBox merge.

One active consumer adoption; preserve green/armed work on newer release; supersede only unopened/unarmed stale work or freshness-failed work. Resume every push/PR/merge partial failure without duplicate/destructive updates; closed PRs owner exceptions. Done live develop pin/hash matches intended/newer accepted identity. Exceptions only, separate monitor issue for check failure without closing real issues; bounded waits and source-review nonapproval issues. Kill switch every mutation, dry-run truly no writes; disabled by default until activation item.
